text:
Alex Chen: Seeing spikes of 521/526 errors at the edge in eu-west-1 after yesterday's mTLS change. ALBs sometimes drop to default cert and we see 'unable to get local issuer' in logs. Anyone tracking this?

Maria Gomez: Yup. Alerts started ~03:12UTC. Appears limited to nat-gw-2 egress path and a subset of backend hosts.

Dan Patel: I pulled a tcpdump from one of the affected nodes. TLS handshake where server only sends leaf cert, no intermediate. ALB then falls back to default cert -> host mismatch -> 521. snippet:```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = app.prod.internal
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=app.prod.internal
   i:/CN=intermediate.prod-ca
---
(s_server didn't send intermediate)
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z -> ingress-nginx v1.3.4 rolled at 1775067600 (10% traffic).

Priya Singh: Two quick hypotheses: 1) Ingress controller secret was updated with cert.pem (leaf) instead of fullchain.pem. 2) Some backends use proxy‑ssl_trusted_certificate misconfig so they don't present full chain on upstream TLS.

Jordan Lee: Also check ALB listener mode. If we moved to TLS termination + re‑encrypt to backend, ALB expects full chain from backend for mutual TLS. If SNI fallback triggers because cert validation fails, ALB swaps to default listener cert.

cert-bot: cert-rotation job for prod returned 409 for a subset of imports at 1775067702, messages: "import conflict - intermediate chain missing".

Dan Patel: Confirmed: k8s secret for ingress in namespace 'prod-ingress' contains only `tls.crt` leaf file (we grabbed the secret). Upstream nginx config uses `ssl_certificate` that points to that secret file.

Priya Singh: Workaround: replace secret with a fullchain (leaf + intermediate) then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress-nginx -n prod-ingress`. That usually fixes chain issues. I'll prepare a patch.

Maria Gomez: I'm going to run the patch in eu-west-1 canary (10 pods). If that clears, we promote. Also checking nat-gw-2 logs to ensure no packet MTU or truncation (but tcpdump shows full handshake).

Dan Patel: Also found one app service that terminates TLS itself and has its own cert store missing intermediate. Need to push fix to helm chart: concat fullchain into `tls.crt` during secret creation.

Jordan Lee: Long term: add a CI check that validates secret contains a complete chain and fail rotation imports otherwise. Also consider ALB config: prefer host-header rule priority before SNI fallback so wrong chain less likely to hit default cert.

oncall: Acknowledged. Priya, tag me when canary is up and I'll watch error budget and pager thresholds.

Priya Singh: Patch is ready, running on canary now. Command I used: `kubectl create secret tls prod-fullchain -n prod-ingress --cert=fullchain.pem --key=priv.key --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress-nginx -n prod-ingress`

Dan Patel: After the restart, I see handshakes now include intermediate and ALB stops falling back. Metrics trending down.

Maria Gomez: Canary looks good for 8 minutes, promoting to 50% then 100% over next 15m. Rolling update to update helm templates to generate fullchain from cert + intermediate.

Alex Chen: Nice work. Action items: (1) emergency hotfix to ensure fullchain in secrets (Priya); (2) helm chart fix + CI cert-chain validation (Dan + Jordan); (3) cert-rotation job fix to fail clearly when intermediate missing (cert-bot owner); (4) follow-up postmortem/notes in incidents channel.

oncall: Will escalate to incident if errors reappear. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Thanks all :rocket:
